releaseRequirement: Require **at least one qualified baseline for every released harness capability** at the first enterprise release.

requiredInterfaces: Versioned provider manifest, adapter artifact, external binding and qualification record
Explicit external-target policy separate from distributed-software licenses
Compiler admission and compatibility with closed existing schemas
acceptance: External lifecycle and zero-cost entitlement admission vectors

requiredInterfaces: Independent extension contract kit and evidence format
Real target qualification distinguished from fake surface tests
acceptance: Reject counterfeit qualification and tenant-acceptance claims
Offline package and independently scoped target evidence
Tenant registry isolation and no built-in shadowing
Unknown/metered charges block; support ownership persists
No duplicate registry or browser fan-out
Cross-tenant requests fail; stale evidence explicit
Distinct install health, capability readiness and support responsibility

requiredInterfaces: Mode-aware minimal bundle and immutable dependency closure
Approved adapter artifacts and local binding references
acceptance: No bundled proprietary runtime or model download

requiredInterfaces: Explicit immutable-profile upgrade and migration contract
acceptance: Stateful migration/export/reindex and honest rollback limits
